$comment: The source of sf-file-upload's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/file-upload (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/file-upload/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

name.summary: The form name the files are submitted under: one entry per file -- the File of a chosen one, the stored id (value) of a sent one.

size.summary: The step of the field ladder, as sf-input's (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3): the words of the area on the size's text, its padding and gap from the space ladder, the label, the help mark and the line of files left out a step below. A file's row keeps the file family's three sizes (1/2 under 1/3, 2 under 3).

label.summary: The visible label above the area, in the text ink a step below the area's text, as every field's (C153 (1)); it names the area unless the page gave it an aria-label. With required the label gets the «*» in its ink. Empty: no label row.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» (sf-help-mark, C133's look) after the label text (C153 (8)): a step below the area's text as the label; the label row keeps its height. The mark is named by its subject («Подробнее: <label>»). Empty, or without a label: no mark.

link-text.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Click to upload" in English).

formats.summary: Formats line shown under the action. When not set it is derived from accept, and is empty when neither is given: the component names no formats it cannot know.

supporting-text.summary: Supporting line; falls back to formats.

max-size.summary: The largest file in bytes; 0 for none. A larger file is not added and is said under the area (reason size).

min-size.summary: The smallest file in bytes; 0 for none (reason min-size). An empty file is never added (reason empty).

max-files.summary: How many files a multiple area lists at most; 0 for none (reason count). A single area keeps one and replaces it.

max-total-size.summary: The listed files together in bytes; 0 for none (reason total).

required.summary: The form will not submit without a file: value-missing «Добавьте файл» (multiple: «Добавьте хотя бы один файл»), and the browser points at the area.

invalid.summary: The shown invalid state: the drop zone's dashed edge in the error role.

error-message.summary: The text shown under the control while it is invalid, in the error colour: what is wrong, as every field of the family says it (sf-input, sf-input-choice); the native control is described by it. Nothing is drawn without invalid.
Why an error entry did not go: its own line under the name (FU-5)

retry-text.summary: The retry button's label in a class row; a Smart row (sf-file-preview) says its own «Повторить <имя>»

image-url.summary: The row's picture for any file, written imageUrl on the entry: a photo's thumbnail, a video's frame or a PDF's page the server made (C149 (4)). A chosen photo (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, SVG) shows its own bytes without it.

stored.summary: The file is stored where removing it erases it (a media library): its remove is the trash «Удалить <имя>», asked in the row first, and detach carries action delete. Without it remove is «×» «Убрать <имя>», at once, given back by «Вернуть» (C149 (8), C25).

items.summary: The files and their uploads: a choice or a drop lists each file ready (chosen, not sent); the host, or the uploader, moves it to process with progress 0-100, then done or error. Each entry in process is a stream (§10.8)

uploader.summary: The page's transfer, a property: async function (file, {signal, onProgress, item}) answering the stored value ({value, href} or an id). With it the component sends each listed file (ready, or retried) and moves the row itself: process with the share onProgress(done, total) reports, done with the value, error with the thrown error's message and reason. Remove aborts it through signal. Without it the host drives the rows through items and answers retry.

value.summary: The files the form gets, in the sf-input-image shape: {label, mime, size, file} for a chosen file sent with the form, {value, label, mime, size, href} for a stored one. Written, it lists stored files as done rows; the attribute takes the list as JSON or addresses separated by commas.

change.summary: Files were chosen: the native event from the inner file input for a pick, and a CustomEvent from the area for a drop (detail files and source 'drop'), so a form hears of both.

attach.summary: Files were selected for upload. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:select follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

attached.summary: A file entered the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-add follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

action.summary: remove: «×» took the file out of the list (nothing is erased; «Вернуть» gives it back). delete: a stored file the person chose to erase after the row asked (C149 (8)): the page erases it.

detach.summary: A file was removed from the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:remove follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rejected.summary: Each file left out: {file, name, reason, message}; reason type, count or duplicate (FU-6, FU-7), size, min-size, empty or total with the limits (FU-8)

Files a choice or a drop left out, each with its reason and message: a type the accept list does not name (on a pick as on a drop), a second file on a single area, a file already listed. The same words show under the area. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:reject follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

retry.summary: A failed file was retried: the row is back in process with progress null (the bar runs without a number) until the transfer reports its share; the uploader sends the file again, a page without one answers this event. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:retry follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

begun.summary: An entry entered process -- chosen, dropped or retried: its upload stream began (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §10.8, vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.2).

chunk.summary: The host moved an entry's progress while it is in process: {id, done, total} with total 100 (§10.8).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

completed.summary: A file finished uploading. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

failed.summary: A file failed. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-error follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

cancelled.summary: An entry left while in process -- removed by the person or by the host: its stream ended without completing (§10.8).

finished.summary: Every file finished. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

remove-item.summary: Remove the item at this index from the list; an index outside the list does nothing. Returns the element.

clear.summary: Empty the list. Returns the element.

relations.name: cl-file-preview
$comment: Each file's row is sf-file-preview (owner decisions C81, C149): asked for when the first file is listed.

relations.name: cl-help-mark
$comment: The «?» after the label (help, owner decision C153 (8)) is sf-help-mark: fetched with the field.

skeleton.$comment: The files already sent arrive as items after the first paint when the host loads them: the derived skeleton (static/default/<example>.skeleton.html) holds their box until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4; first-paint study R222).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim

rows.summary: Files were selected for upload. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rows.note: the detail adds id; the old fields are all there
rows.summary: A file entered the list. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-attached with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).
A file was removed from the list. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-detach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

Dropped files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-rejected with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).
A failed file was retried. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-retry with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rows.note: the end of the stream; the detail adds id
rows.summary: A file finished uploading. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-completed with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rows.note: the end of the stream; the detail adds id, reason and message
rows.summary: A file failed. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-failed with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).
Every file finished. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-finished with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

x-summary: A drop area that opens the platform file dialog or takes dropped files, filtered by accept, and lists each file with its upload progress, an error with a retry, and removal. The host uploads; the component shows the state the host sets.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.sf-file-upload-retry → retry (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)

lang runtime also holds the words of FILE_UPLOAD_ITEM_TEXT (ui-source/src/component/file-upload/js/_file_upload.js): a shared script this component draws with (§11: no word lives only inside a bundle)
settings.text: its default words move to lang/en.json runtime.text (§11, §16 item 44)
x-decisions: alias-conflict: vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1 decides -- the colon names follow attach, attached, detach, rejected, retry, completed, failed and finished; stand 18's planned hyphen names (sf-file-upload-select, -file-add, …) never shipped and get no alias
completed, not uploaded: vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1 names the end of an upload stream completed (§5.2, standard §10.8); 1.1.2 had planned -uploaded

streams (§10.8): each entry is a stream keyed by its id -- begun when it enters process (a choice, a drop, a retry), chunk {done, total} when the host moves its progress, then exactly one of completed (done), failed {reason, message} (error) or cancelled (removed while in process); finished when every entry is done
version: 1.1.0 -- eight events take their vocabulary names behind dated aliases, and begun, chunk and cancelled are added; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10)
key-effects: Enter and Space on the area open the platform file dialog
setter: items is a writable list setting (§4.4: no set-<name> action, no rule calls it); setItems stays a method of the class outside the interface
item-shape: id, name, file-size, progress, state, error-message, retry-text, file
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json and the docs
css-variables: seven public variables read by the class sheet with the role as fallback, the dragged-over pair among them (§6)
actions answer outcomes (§4.4): remove-item {index} and clear are applied, or refused no-item / unchanged
host-states: data-dragged-over while files are held over the area (§5.3); the class component keeps its .dragover class

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
version 1.1.7 (2026-11-07): the first-paint snapshot of the progress example carries sf-progress-bar 1.2.0's host state data-status. Markup only; behaviour unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-15, owner decisions C81 and C149 (8), register RG-S1-33; component.file-upload 1.3.0): a minor. Each file's row is the family's file row, sf-file-preview (C81: one family, one row height -- the 48 holder of sf-file-preview, sf-file-download and the image field, where the area's own row was 68 at size 1): a chosen photo shows its own picture and any file the host's imageUrl, any other file the glyph of its type and the type word in the grey tile; the line under the name is type · size, the bar with its per cent while the file goes, «Не загрузился: <reason>» and «Повторить» after a failure. A sent file with its address is a link. Remove is «×» «Убрать <имя>» at once (C149 (8)); the notice gives the file back with «Вернуть» (C25), a file that was on its way coming back ready; an entry the host marks stored is the trash «Удалить <имя>», asked in the row, and detach carries action remove | delete. The focus goes to the row that took the removed one's place, else the area. The rows stand 12 apart (--sf-space-1/2; 8 compact), the study's list gap, where they stood 16. The class rows of ordinary markup take «×» «Убрать <имя>» too. Settings unchanged; items take image-url and stored; detach carries action.

They drew 1/2 and 2 with a console note. A file's row keeps the file family's three sizes (sf-file-preview; a class row 1/2 under 1/3, 2 under 3). New settings label and help (C153 (1), (2), (8); the family's names): a label above the area in the text ink a step below its words (14 at size 1, on a phone too), the required «*» in its ink, the «?» of help after them (sf-help-mark, named «Подробнее: <label>», lang help); the label names the area (aria-labelledby) unless the page gave aria-label. With component.file-upload 1.6.0 (the outer steps and the label in _css__file_upload_ladder.scss, class markup takes the steps, no retired-size class move). 1/2, 1 and 2 unchanged; events and keys unchanged.

version 1.5.1 (written on the branch as 1.4.1; 2026-11-16, owner decision C260; sf-file-preview 1.5.0, component.file-upload 1.4.1): a patch. ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-upload for local file selection and item-state presentation. Consumer code owns transport and server validation. Shared root-class/style/root-style customize the drop zone, not the adjacent file list; cosmetic renders preserve item File objects. afterRender(callback) uses the base registration API.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: The enabled drop zone is the picker focus owner; nested file actions retain native activation. Use focus-visible and a real forced-colors outline. Disabled controls leave the tab order; re-enabling restores authored tabindex.
